set.body: Expand the hardened graphics core (typed AesEnv, phased compiler, scale-derived guides, layout solver, device-resolved backends, renderer conformance contract) with the plot semantics a full plotting system needs. Each issue must preserve the renderer-neutral Plot -> TrainedPlot -> Scene -> DeviceScene -> backend pipeline, keep the conformance contract green, and pass JVM+JS tests. Sequenced after the elegance-hardening epic (bd-01KX2DBPK8R7K8PGH3PVZAMPCQ), which is complete.
set.title: Epic: graphics target-10 semantic expansion
